items.description: Upload one PDF and ask focused questions. The native Docling extension extracts the document text, and the model answers with short verbatim quotations and explicit unknowns. Up to 60,000 characters of text are analysed; the report says when a longer document was read only in part. Requires the Docling extension 0.3.0 or later, a configured Docling service and a model connection. No public-URL fallback, persistent chat memory, guaranteed page citations or external actions.

items.description: Create a one-time regional sales review from an uploaded UTF-8 CSV. Native operations validate rows and unique order IDs, calculate revenue totals and order counts, and check complete coverage of 1–1000 regional groups before model interpretation. Space-grouped numbers must be cleaned before upload. Returns reusable regional_summary data and a non-empty model-assisted report; the CSV download is available in Job Details, not as a callable File output. Invalid, empty or oversized regional summaries stop with an error; intermediate job files may remain. No currency conversion or external updates.
